SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_FinancialProductGrouping_DID] AS
BEGIN


WITH TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductGrouping AS
(
	SELECT DISTINCT
		BDP.BANK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,BDP.SOURCE_CODE AS SourceCode
		,BDP.PRODUCT_GROUP AS ProductGrouping
		,BDP.PRODUCT_TYPE AS FinancialProductId
		,BDP.PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION AS FinancialProductName
		,BDP.INSERT_DTTM AS PeriodStartTimestamp
		,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndTimestamp
		,'DID' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
		--,'INSERT' AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING BDP
	WHERE ISLATEST = '1' --AND BDP.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'FGUA'

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductGrouping FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductGrouping;
--select count(1) from  #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductGrouping


WITH TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductGrouping_SRC AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			CONVERT(VARCHAR,FinancialProductId)
			,FinancialProductName
			,FinancialInstitutionId
			,SourceCode
			,ProductGrouping
			--,PeriodStartTimestamp
			--,PeriodEndTimestamp
			)) AS HASHROW
			,FinancialProductId ,SourceCode ,FinancialInstitutionId --,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductGrouping --WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)


,TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductGrouping_TGT AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			CONVERT(VARCHAR,FinancialProductId)
			,FinancialProductName
			,FinancialInstitutionId
			,SourceCode
			,ProductGrouping
			--,PeriodStartTimestamp
			--,PeriodEndTimestamp
			)) AS HASHROW
			,FinancialProductId ,SourceCode ,FinancialInstitutionId
	FROM BNKM.FinancialProductGrouping WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DID'
),

TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductGrouping_DELTA AS
(
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialProductId,TGT.FinancialProductId) AS FinancialProductId
		,ISNULL(SRC.SourceCode,TGT.SourceCode) AS SourceCode
		,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,CASE
			WHEN TGT.FinancialProductId IS NULL AND TGT.SourceCode IS NULL AND TGT.FinancialInstitutionId IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
			ELSE NULL 
		END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductGrouping_SRC SRC
	LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductGrouping_TGT TGT
	 ON SRC.FinancialProductId = TGT.FinancialProductId
	 AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
	 AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductGrouping_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductGrouping_DELTA;

----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = DATEADD(DAY,-1,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp)))
FROM BNKM.FinancialProductGrouping TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductGrouping_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.FinancialProductId = TGT.FinancialProductId AND DELTA.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductGrouping SRC ON SRC.FinancialProductId = TGT.FinancialProductId AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp in ('9999-12-31')


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.FinancialProductGrouping ( 
FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceCode
,ProductGrouping
,FinancialProductId
,FinancialProductName
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,SRC.SourceCode AS SourceCode
,SRC.ProductGrouping AS ProductGrouping
,SRC.FinancialProductId AS FinancialProductId
,SRC.FinancialProductName AS FinancialProductName
,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,SRC.PeriodEndTimestamp AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,'DID' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId 
,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductGrouping SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductGrouping_DELTA DELTA ON   DELTA.FinancialProductId = SRC.FinancialProductId AND DELTA.SourceCode = SRC.SourceCode AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT','UPDATE')


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductGrouping;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductGrouping_DELTA;

END
GO
